_comment: 'When this attacks, it gets -1{p} unless you pay {r}.' TRIGGERED + ON_ATTACK is the documented shape for an Action - Attack card's on-attack pump (an Action-Attack is NOT an ATTACK_REACTION); ON_ATTACK fires even if the attack is later fully blocked, which matches 'when this attacks'. PAY_OR_ELSE (effect_types.py:3207) reads 'resources' and 'player' - player defaults to SELF, which is the printed 'you' (the attacking card's controller) - and runs on_failure when unpaid; a controller who cannot afford {r} is not asked and simply suffers the -1. on_failure specs are compiled eagerly at load, so the nested MODIFY_ATTACK fails loudly if mistyped. MODIFY_ATTACK (effect_types.py:4123) reads mod/amount, and its one-shot trigger path records on combat.power_mods so the -1 survives later recalculations - the handler's own comment cites this exact 'when this attacks' pattern. Negative amount with mod add is the DSL_REFERENCE spelling for subtraction. No conditions: the clause is unconditional.
